summary: NextEra Energy filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) disclosing a September 22, 2026 order by the Circuit Court of the 15th Judicial Circuit, Palm Beach County, Florida, scheduling a December 14, 2026 Settlement Hearing in the shareholder derivative action Davidson, et al. v. Silagy, et al., Case No. 50-2023-CA-012434. The hearing will consider approval of a proposed derivative settlement resolving the Davidson action and related derivative actions and shareholder demands, plus agreed attorneys' fees and expenses. Notice and a Revised Stipulation and Agreement of Settlement dated July 29, 2026 were filed as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2. No transaction terms; watch settlement approval and any governance changes.
